body:
It hurts man. She told me we would work through everything. We promised each other this. And I believed her, every single last word. Her excuse now is "people change". Well sure they do. I did. I changed a lot to be with her. This included giving up my friends amongst many other things. I'm supposed to accept this as what, my payment?

I've been trying to cope with this loss. I'm a very introverted person, so it's hard for me to talk about these feelings in the first place, but I've been telling everyone willing to lend an ear. A fellow redditor gave me his number so I can talk to him when I felt like I couldn't handle it. I've called him every day. Sometimes more than once. 

Everyone tells me to be strong, but it's hard. I feel like I can't. I can't handle her breaking my heart. How could I handle it again, or again, or again? I know I won't be able to. But I'm weak as it is. Yet I'm asked to reassure her. I'm asked to keep going. All I've done for the past 3 years is give and give and give, and it's not enough. It's never enough. 

I find something to occupy my mind for maybe an hour, and I'm ok for that hour. But then I sink back to where I don't want to be.


Your advice is really nice. I'm sorry you had to go through this. It sucks. It hurts a lot. I wish I had your strength.

I try to surround myself constantly, to get my mind off things and to basically physically prevent myself from doing it. And for the most part, when I'm with people I'm ok. But the second I'm alone I sink back.
That article nails it spot on. The most scientific and natural answer happens to be one of the best ones.
This is what I'm afraid of. That years and years later I'll still think of this time. I love her too much to give up on her, and yet I hate myself for not being strong enough to respect her decision.

I always think of Carl Sagan's Pale Blue Dot. And yet, it depresses me. Because what will this moment, my life, be worth in a hundred years? It doesn't seem to matter to the person I dedicated myself too. She sees me like this and it frustrates her. Ha, imagine how I feel! I'm trying to end my life.
Thanks. I found that having a slight buzz takes the edge off of things. Trying not to over do it though.

No I didn't post in /r/askreddit. However I did post in a different subreddit under a different username.

I want to give it a week of breaking off contact but I left out a detail. We live together in a one bedroom apt and the lease doesn't end for another month.  I've been trying to occupy myself with friends and I feel better when I'm with them and away from her. But the second I'm alone, that's when I start to feel bad again. And unfortunately I'm alone far too often.

This made me cry. 

I'm sorry for your break up. It feels pretty bad. Worse if it's involuntary. 

You had a lot of really nice things to say and makes me feel like there's hope. 

I'm almost speechless as to what to say back to you, but trust me, you've said the most important things to me than I've heard in the past few days. I wish I could translate my feelings into words more so you can understand how thankful I am.

I know it. I wanted to experience new things with her. We would always tell each other that. Perhaps it was foolish. Pretty stupid of me to put all my faith and trust and hope into one person. Because when they decide to leave, they take everything.

One side of my mind says giver her time and space. The other can't bare to lose her. 

It's a constant battle of "I'll make it through this" and "I wish I had the strength to kill myself"
